sentences.text: [deadpan, dry humor] Nine countries have the bomb, and each got it in a stranger way.
America's bomb town had one address: a P.O. box.
The Soviets? They had a spy.
Britain set its first one off inside a warship.
France tested in the Sahara, then cabled: Hooray for France!
China named its bomb five ninety-six, the month the Soviets quit helping.
India's message home: the Buddha has smiled.
[slightly surprised] Israel? Officially, it's never admitted one.
Pakistan's came seventeen days after India's, and turned a mountain white.
[deadpan, dry humor] And North Korea's first one barely went off.
Comment the country you want the full story on.
